Subject..................................."The China Daily News"
Made by....................and....................Forwarded by..D.S. McKeown

On August 22 Ho Kung-ying (胡躬行), publisher
and editor of the "China Daily News" (中國日報), gave
the following information to C.A. Loh Sih-kyas:-
"On August 19 I received a manuscript from a
Japanese who is connected with the Shanghai Press Censorship
Bureau with a request that it be published in my newspaper
as an editorial. I did publish it in my paper on August 20
(translation attached marked "A") but all allegations and
criticisms directed against the S.M.C. were deleted or
altered by me. However, the Japanese had made a translation
of the article before its publication in my paper. Thus,
(translation marked "B")
the Japanese text of the article/published by the "Mainichi"
on August 21 is different from the one appearing in my paper.
As the Japanese are dissatisfied with my action, I have
decided to suspend the publication of my paper temporarily
as from August 22 because if I were to act as directed by
the Japanese, I believe that my paper will eventually be
suppressed by the S.M.C. The Japanese, however, advised
me not to be afraid and said that arrangements have already
been made with four Chinese papers to criticize and denounce
the S.M.C. at their direction."
Upon being asked the amount of the subsidy given
to him monthly, Ho Kung-ying explained that he had not
received any funds from the Japanese in question but he had
an agreement drawn up between himself and the Japanese wherein
the latter would pay $300 a month as subscription for 500
copies per issue of his paper.

1938年8月22日，《中国日报》（China Daily News）的出版商兼编辑胡躬行 (Ho Kung-ying) 向 C.A. Loh Sih-kyas 提供了以下信息：
“8月19日，我收到一名与上海新闻检查局有联系的日本人递交的一份手稿，并要求将其作为社论刊登在我的报纸上。我确实在8月20日的报纸上刊登了该文（附译文，标记为‘A’），但我删除或修改了所有针对工部局（S.M.C.）的指控和批评。然而，该日本人在我的报纸刊登之前已将该文章翻译成日文。因此，（标记为‘B’的译文）
8月21日《每日新闻》刊登的文章日文版与我报刊登的版本不同。由于日本人对我此举表示不满，我决定自8月22日起暂时停刊，因为如果我按日本人的指示行事，我相信我的报纸最终会被工部局查封。然而，日本人劝我不要害怕，并称已安排四家中文报纸按照他们的指示批评和谴责工部局。”
当被问及每月给予他的津贴数额时，胡躬行解释说，他并未从该日本人那里收到任何资金，但他与该日本人之间达成了一项协议，由后者以每月300元的价格订阅其报纸每期500份。

China Daily News (中國日報) publishes the following editorial :-
20.8.38.
Maintenance of Peace in the Settlement

Under foreign protection the 3,000,000
Chinese residents in the Foreign Settlements of Shanghai
have been able to conduct their business in peace. It is
not surprising therefore that people in the interior are
flocking into the Foreign Settlements of Shanghai.
Here we wish to express our admiration for the
authorities of the Foreign Settlements for their untiring
efforts in the maintenance of peace and order.
While living in this haven, certain elements
have been committing unlawful acts. This is a challenge
to the authorities. Such people are public enemies. In
the past assassinations have taken place but they were
solved by the authorities. The investigations revealed
that they had been committed by individuals either out of
private grudge or through public indignation.
Now in broad daylight and on a busy street,
an attack has been made by five armed desperadoes on a
Police officer of the rank of Superintendent whose duty was
to preserve peace and order in the Settlement.
On the eve of the first anniversary of August
13, it was generally feared that peace and order in the
Settlement might be impaired. The day, however, passed
off without any untoward incidents and for this we are
thankful to the Settlement authorities for the adequate
precautionary measures adopted in advance. Naturally, the
late Superintendent Loh Lim-kwe was one of the officers
charged with enforcing these precautionary measures.
Nevertheless, Superintendent Loh was murdered five days
after the anniversary. Although it remains to be
ascertained whether the motive of his murder is due to
private grudge or jealousy of his official position, we
cannot help entertaining a fear for the future peace and
order of the Settlement. It is earnestly hoped that the
Settlement authorities will take more steps to preserve
peace and order in the district where 3,000,000 Chinese
residents are taking shelter.

《中国日报》刊登如下社论：-
1938年8月20日。
租界内的和平维持

在上海外国租界内，300万中国居民在外国的保护下得以安居乐业。因此，内地民众纷纷涌入上海外国租界也就不足为奇了。
在此，我们要对外国租界当局为维护和平与秩序所作出的不懈努力表示钦佩。
虽然生活在这个避风港中，但某些分子一直在从事非法活动。这是对当局的挑战。此类人是公敌。过去曾发生过暗杀事件，但均被当局侦破。调查显示，这些案件要么是因私人恩怨，要么是出于公愤而由个人所为。
如今，在大白天的繁忙街道上，五名武装暴徒袭击了一名负责维护租界和平与秩序的警司级警官。
在“八一三”一周年前夕，人们普遍担心租界的和平与秩序可能会受到破坏。然而，这一天平安度过，未发生任何不幸事件，为此我们要感谢租界当局提前采取了充分的预防措施。当然，已故警司罗林贵 (Loh Lim-kwe) 是负责执行这些预防措施的官员之一。
尽管如此，罗警司在周年纪念日后五天遇害。虽然其遇害动机是出于私人恩怨还是嫉妒其职位尚待查明，但我们不禁对租界未来的和平与秩序感到担忧。恳切希望租界当局采取更多措施，以维护这300万中国居民避难所在地区的和平与秩序。

August 21, 1938.

LAI_ICHI

MR. MURDER OF LOH LIEN-KWEI OFFENSIVE ATTITUDE OF S.M.C.
EXPOSED: CHINA DAILY NEWS ADVISES S.M.C. TO REFLECT

While the S.M.P. authorities are
boasting of the effectiveness of the precautionary measures
adopted on August 13 to prevent acts of terrorism, Superintendent
Loh Lien-kwe of the S.M.P. was assassinated by terrorists
and the residents of Shanghai were thrown into a state of
panic.

The "China Daily News," a Chinese
newspaper, published the following leading article under the
headline "The question of peace and order of the Settlement"
drawing the attention of the S.M.C. to this matter. This
article is noteworthy for both this paper and the "North
China Daily News" have published leading articles on the
question of peace and order in the Settlement.

The "China Daily News" wrote:- "While
the hostilities are affecting various places along China's
coasts, the Foreign Settlements in Shanghai, due to their
special status, are enjoying peace and order in a comparative
degree. Since the outbreak of the hostilities, a large
number of Chinese people have flocked into the Foreign
Settlements for they rely upon the special status of the
Settlements and the efficiency of the authorities to preserve
peace and order. On several occasions this paper has
drawn the attention of the Foreign Settlement authorities
to the preservation of peace and to their responsibility in
the matter because acts of terrorism have frequently taken
place. Whether or not it was due to the articles of
this paper, August 13 passed off quietly because the authorities
had adopted adequate measures. For this, the residents are
thankful to the Settlement authorities. Nevertheless,

1938年8月21日。

LAICHI（音译）

罗连贵 (LOH LIEN-KWEI) 遇害案：工部局 (S.M.C.) 的进攻性态度暴露无遗；《中国日报》劝告工部局反思

正当工部局警务处 (S.M.P.) 当局吹嘘其在8月13日采取的防止恐怖主义行为的预防措施行之有效之际，工部局警务处警司罗连贵 (Loh Lien-kwe) 却被恐怖分子暗杀，上海居民陷入恐慌状态。

中文报纸《中国日报》以“租界治安问题”为标题发表了以下社论，提请工部局注意此事。这篇文章值得注意，因为本报和《字林西报》都就租界治安问题发表了社论。

《中国日报》写道：“虽然战事影响中国沿海各地，但上海的外国租界因其特殊地位，相对享有和平与秩序。自战事爆发以来，大量中国人涌入外国租界，因为他们依赖租界的特殊地位以及当局维护和平与秩序的效率。本报曾多次提请外国租界当局注意维护和平及其在此事上的责任，因为恐怖主义行为频繁发生。不知是否因为本报的文章，8月13日因当局采取了充分措施而平静度过。为此，居民们感谢租界当局。尽管如此，

Superintendent Loh Lien-kwe was murdered five days after
the anniversary. Although we are not concerned
whether the motive of the murder is private grudge or public
indignation, we wish to emphasize that this act of
terrorism took place in broad daylight in the business
centre. Loh Lien-kwe was one of the responsible
officers dealing with terrorists. We would like to
know what the S.M.C. authorities are doing. We cannot
help entertaining a doubt about the efficiency of the
S.M.C. to maintain peace and order. As regards the

In spite of this, we have witnessed this act of terrorism.
It is most regrettable. What about the prestige of the

China Daily News ( 中国日报, a mosquito daily, published
the following editorial on July 1, 1938.

THE MAINTENANCE OF PEACE: RATEPAYERS' RIGHT TO
QUESTION THE AUTHORITIES

Probably every resident in Shanghai ... the
feeling that this isolated island is now like a hell on
earth. Large captions appear in newspapers every day
reporting that a certain traitor or anti-Japanese element
has been killed or beheaded. One paper even stated that
several assassinations had taken place within 48 hours.
This frightful situation has prevailed since the beginning
of 1938, so much so that almost every citizen is becoming
anxious about his personal safety. This is most
unfortunate and constitutes a serious problem for the
authorities of the two Foreign Settlements.
The Foreign Settlements of Shanghai are densely
populated by people of all nationalities. All kinds of
evils are to be found. This has become more apparent
since the withdrawal of the Chinese forces from Shanghai.
In the community of Shanghai, persons are contending
against other persons, struggles are going on between one
party and another and one nation is acting against another
nation. Thus there is always a possibility of an
unfortunate incident arising at any time. However,
safety and peace and order must be maintained. The
occurrence of a case of assassination will destroy peace
and order.
Shanghai has a complicated community and when
a case of assassination occurs, the victimized party
will take reprisals and thus a vicious circle is created.
In this way, thousands of assassinations may occur and the
reign of terror may go on for a long time. It is thus
that human beings in this Twentieth Century are killing
one another like beasts. What a sad reflection!
These murders, whether carried out for private
grudge or public vengeance, were not committed without
reason. In Shanghai, wherein conditions are so complicated,
it is very easy for one to make enemies.
However, it is the responsibility of the
authorities to maintain peace and order and to prevent
such crimes before they are perpetrated and to punish
the assassins after they are perpetrated. Since the
beginning of this year, many such acts of terrorism have
taken place in Shanghai. The authorities have not only been
powerless to put a stop to them before they are carried
out, but they have arrested only a few of the offenders.
This, in the eyes of peaceful residents, who are eagerly
longing for peace in the Foreign Settlements, is indeed
a matter for profound regret.
Shanghai is an international metropolis, known for
its advanced state of civilization and progress. Yet it has
now become a hell because of the many cases of assassinations
that have taken place even in broad daylight. If the
situation is allowed to continue, the 3,000,000 citizens of
Shanghai will become uneasy. The authorities are directly
or indirectly collecting taxes and municipal rates from the
3,000,000 citizens, therefore they are under an obligation
to preserve peace and good order in the Foreign Settlements.

《中国日报》（一家微不足道的日报）于1938年7月1日刊登了以下社论。

维持和平：纳税人质问当局之权利

上海每位居民可能都有这种感觉，即这座孤岛如今如同人间地狱。报纸每天都以大标题报道某汉奸或反日分子被杀或被斩首。甚至有一家报纸称，在48小时内发生了数起暗杀事件。这种可怕的局面自1938年初以来一直盛行，以至于几乎每个市民都开始担心自己的人身安全。这是非常不幸的，也构成了两个外国租界当局面临的严重问题。
上海的外国租界人口稠密，各族人士杂居。各种罪恶随处可见。自中国军队撤离上海以来，这种情况变得更加明显。在上海社区中，人与人相争，派系与派系斗争，一国对抗另一国。因此，随时都有可能发生不幸事件。然而，必须维持安全、和平与秩序。发生暗杀案件将破坏和平与秩序。
上海社区复杂，一旦发生暗杀案件，受害方将进行报复，从而形成恶性循环。这样一来，可能发生成千上万起暗杀，恐怖统治可能持续很长时间。这就是为什么二十世纪的人类像野兽一样互相残杀。多么可悲的景象！
这些谋杀案，无论是出于私人恩怨还是公众复仇，都不是无缘无故发生的。在上海这样条件复杂的地方，一个人很容易树敌。
然而，当局有责任维持和平与秩序，在犯罪实施前予以预防，并在犯罪实施后惩罚刺客。自今年年初以来，上海发生了许多此类恐怖主义行为。当局不仅无力在行为实施前加以制止，而且仅逮捕了少数罪犯。这在渴望外国租界和平的和平居民眼中，确实是一件令人深感遗憾的事情。
上海是一座国际大都市，以其先进的文明和进步而闻名。然而，由于甚至在光天化日之下也发生了多起暗杀案件，它现在已变成地狱。如果任由局势继续发展，上海300万市民将感到不安。当局直接或间接地从300万市民那里征收税款和市政捐，因此他们有义务维护外国租界的和平与良好秩序。

pages.en:
- 2 -

For this reason, to demand and urge the
authorities of the Foreign Settlements to maintain peace
and good order is the right of every citizen of Shanghai.
Right and obligation are equal terms; if our obligation
is not fulfilled, it means that we have lost our right.
Thus, we have to urge upon the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements to pay close attention to the present state
of affairs in the Foreign Settlements.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

因此，要求并敦促外国租界当局维持和平与良好秩序是每位上海市民的权利。权利与义务是对等的；如果我们的义务未履行，就意味着我们失去了权利。因此，我们必须敦促外国租界当局密切关注外国租界目前的局势。

Confidential
Date July 5, 1938.
(Special Branch) Office Notes
Commissioner.
Sir,
I learn from the Editor of the China Daily News that
this article emanated from Japanese sources (Kato's office).
He realizes now that it was given him to permit the Japanese
press to point to it as Chinese opinion - Nippo refers to it
as "Mocking at police measures".
The Editor suggested writing a leader correcting
inaccuracies in the article, but I told him to leave
well alone and confine himself in future to comment fair
to men who have to face fire of armed criminals nigh daily.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 5 JULY 1938）
D. C. (Special Branch)
pages.zh:
机密
日期：1938年7月5日。
（特别处）办公备忘录
致警务总监。
先生，
我从《中国日报》编辑处获悉，这篇文章源自日本方面（加藤 (Kato) 的办公室）。他现在意识到，给他这篇文章是为了让日本媒体将其指称为中国人的意见——《日日新闻》（Nippo）称之为“嘲笑警察措施”。
编辑建议写一篇社论纠正文章中的不实之处，但我告诉他不要多事，以后只限于对那些不得不每天面对武装罪犯火力的人进行公正评论。
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1938年7月5日）
副督察长（特别处）

China Daily News (中国日报), a mosquito daily, published the following editorial on July 1,-1938 :-

THE MAINTENANCE OF PEACE: RATEPAYERS' RIGHT TO QUESTION THE AUTHORITIES

Probably every resident in Shanghai has the feeling that this isolated island is now like a hell on earth. Large captions appear in newspapers every day reporting that a certain traitor or anti-Japanese element has been killed or beheaded. One paper even stated that several assassinations had taken place within 48 hours. This frightful situation has prevailed since the beginning of 1938, so much so that almost every citizen is becoming anxious about his personal safety. This is most unfortunate and constitutes a serious problem for the authorities of the two Foreign Settlements.

The Foreign Settlements of Shanghai are densely populated by people of all nationalities. All kinds of evils are to be found. This has become more apparent since the withdrawal of the Chinese forces from Shanghai. In the community of Shanghai, persons are contending against other persons, struggles are going on between one party and another and one nation is acting against another nation. Thus there is always a possibility of an unfortunate incident arising at any time. However, safety and peace and order must be maintained. The occurrence of a case of assassination will destroy peace and order.

Shanghai has a complicated community and when a case of assassination occurs, the victimized party will take reprisals and thus a vicious circle is created. In this way, thousands of assassinations may occur and the reign of terror may go on for a long time. It is thus that human beings in this Twentieth Century are killing one another like beasts. What a sad reflection!

These murders, whether carried out for private grudge or public vengeance, were not committed without reason. In Shanghai, wherein conditions are so complicated, it is very easy for one to make enemies.

However, it is the responsibility of the authorities to maintain peace and order and to prevent such crimes before they are perpetrated and to punish the assassins after they are perpetrated. Since the beginning of this year, many such acts of terrorism have taken place in Shanghai. The authorities have not only been powerless to put a stop to them before they are carried out, but they have arrested only a few of the offenders. This, in the eyes of peaceful residents, who are eagerly longing for peace in the Foreign Settlements, is indeed a matter for profound regret.

Shanghai is an international metropolis, known for its advanced state of civilization and progress. Yet it has now become a hell because of the many cases of assassinations that have taken place even in broad daylight. If the situation is allowed to continue, the 3,000,000 citizens of Shanghai will become uneasy. The authorities are directly or indirectly collecting taxes and municipal rates from the 3,000,000 citizens, therefore they are under an obligation to preserve peace and good order in the Foreign Settlements.

For this reason, to demand and urge the authorities of the Foreign Settlements to maintain peace and good order is the right of every citizen of Shanghai. Right and obligation are equal terms; if our obligation is not fulfilled, it means that we have lost our right. Thus, we have to urge upon the authorities of the Foreign Settlements to pay close attention to the present state of affairs in the Foreign Settlements.

《中国日报》（China Daily News），一家微不足道的日报，于1938年7月1日刊登了以下社论：

维持和平：纳税人有权质询当局

或许每一位上海居民都有这样的感觉，这座孤岛如今宛如人间地狱。报纸每天都以醒目标题报道某名汉奸或抗日分子被杀或被斩首。甚至有报纸称，在48小时内发生了数起暗杀事件。这种可怕的局势自1938年初以来一直持续，致使几乎每位市民都开始担忧自身安全。这极为不幸，并构成了两个外国租界当局面临的严重问题。

上海的外国租界聚居着来自各国的人口。各种罪恶层出不穷。自中国军队撤离上海以来，这种情况变得更为明显。在上海社会中，人与人相争，党派与党派相斗，国与国相抗。因此，任何时候都有可能发生不幸事件。然而，必须维持安全、和平与秩序。发生暗杀案件将破坏和平与秩序。

上海社会结构复杂，一旦发生暗杀案件，受害方必将进行报复，从而形成恶性循环。如此一来，成千上万起暗杀可能发生，恐怖统治可能长期持续。这就是二十世纪的人类像野兽般互相残杀的原因。这是多么悲哀的写照！

这些谋杀案，无论是出于私人恩怨还是公共复仇，并非无缘无故发生。在上海这样条件复杂的环境中，人很容易树敌。

然而，当局有责任维持和平与秩序，在犯罪实施前予以预防，并在犯罪实施后惩处刺客。自今年年初以来，上海发生了许多此类恐怖行为。当局不仅无力在罪行实施前加以制止，而且仅逮捕了少数罪犯。这在渴望外国租界和平的和平居民眼中，确实是一件令人深感遗憾的事。

上海是一座国际大都市，以文明和进步程度高而闻名。然而，由于甚至在光天化日之下也发生了多起暗杀案件，它现在已变成地狱。如果任由局势继续发展，上海三百万市民将感到不安。当局直接或间接地向三百万市民征收税款和市政捐，因此他们有义务维护外国租界的和平与良好秩序。

鉴于此，要求并敦促外国租界当局维持和平与良好秩序，是每一位上海市民的权利。权利与义务是对等的；如果我们的义务未履行，即意味着我们失去了权利。因此，我们必须敦促外国租界当局密切关注外国租界目前的局势。

pages.en:
CHINESE NEWSPAPER HOLDS SETTLEMENT AUTHORITIES RESPONSIBLE
FOR ASSASSINATIONS

Mocking at the Police measures,
terrorists have thrown the 3,500,000 people of Shanghai
into a state of panic. The desire for peace and order
has become stronger and stronger.
On July 1 the "China Daily News"
took up the matter and declared assassinations were
taking place in broad daylight and questioned the
responsibility of the Settlement authorities for these
crimes and requested them to put a check to such crimes
and to punish the offenders. The paper further claimed
the right of citizens to urge the authorities to maintain
peace and order.
pages.zh:
中文报纸认为租界当局应对暗杀事件负责

警方措施遭到嘲弄，
恐怖分子使上海三百五十万人民
陷入恐慌状态。对和平与秩序的渴望
日益强烈。
7月1日，《中国日报》
就此发表评论，宣称暗杀事件
在光天化日之下发生，并质疑租界当局
对这些罪行的责任，要求他们制止此类罪行
并惩罚罪犯。该报还声称，
市民有权敦促当局维持
和平与秩序。
